options.name: allow_replace
options.description: Boolean indicating if the resource should be recreated when the state cannot be reached in another way. This may be used to prevent resources from being deleted from specifying a different value to an immutable property. An error will be thrown instead

options.name: annotations
options.description: The annotations attached to the node pool.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: auto_scaling
options.description: Property to be set when auto-scaling needs to be enabled for the nodepool. By default, auto-scaling is not enabled.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: The availability zone in which the target VM should be provisioned.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: cores_count
options.description: The total number of cores for the nodes.

options.name: cpu_family
options.description: The CPU type for the nodes. If this field is null or omitted from the request, an available CPU architecture will be automatically selected. Supplying an empty string is not accepted. | **Deprecated**: This property has been deprecated. For a specific use of a CPU type, use "serverType" instead.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The unique identifier of the data center where the worker nodes of the node pool are provisioned. Note that the data center must be located in the same location as the cluster of the node pool or in one of its associated locations. For private Kubernetes, the data centers of all node pools must be placed at the same location.

options.name: k8s_cluster
options.description: The ID or name of the K8s cluster.

options.name: k8s_nodepool
options.description: The ID or name of the K8s nodepool.

options.name: k8s_version
options.description: The Kubernetes version running in the node pool. Note that this imposes restrictions on which Kubernetes versions can run in the node pools of a cluster. Also, not all Kubernetes versions are suitable upgrade targets for all earlier versions.

options.name: labels
options.description: The labels attached to the node pool.

options.name: lans
options.description: The array of existing private LANs to attach to worker nodes.

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: The maintenance window is used to update the software on the node pool nodes and update the K8s version of the node pool. If no value is specified, a value is selected dynamically, so there is no fixed default value.

options.name: name
options.description: A Kubernetes node pool name. Valid Kubernetes node pool name must be 63 characters or less and must be empty or begin and end with an alphanumeric character ([a-z0-9A-Z]) with dashes (-), underscores (_), dots (.), and alphanumerics between.

options.name: node_count
options.description: The number of worker nodes of the node pool.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: public_ips
options.description: Optional array of reserved public IP addresses to be used by the nodes. The IPs must be from the exact location of the node pool's data center. If autoscaling is used, the array must contain one more IP than the maximum possible number of nodes (nodeCount+1 for a fixed number of nodes or maxNodeCount+1). The extra IP is used when the nodes are rebuilt.

options.name: ram_size
options.description: The RAM size for the nodes. Must be specified in multiples of 1024 MB, with a minimum size of 2048 MB.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: storage_size
options.description: The allocated volume size in GB. The allocated volume size in GB. To achieve good performance, we recommend a size greater than 100GB for SSD.

options.name: storage_type
options.description: The storage type for the nodes.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
